scripts.sync:docs: cp README.md README.ja.md CHANGELOG.md CHANGELOG.ja.md LICENSE packages/core/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of['packages/core/README.md','packages/core/README.ja.md']){fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replaceAll('./packages/core/doc/','./doc/').replaceAll('./packages/react/','../react/').replaceAll('./packages/vue/','../vue/').replaceAll('(./CHANGELOG.md)','(../../CHANGELOG.md)').replaceAll('(./CHANGELOG.ja.md)','(../../CHANGELOG.ja.md)'))}" && cp LICENSE packages/plugin-export/ && cp LICENSE packages/plugin-excel/ && cp LICENSE packages/react/ && cp LICENSE packages/vue/
scripts.build: pnpm sync:docs && pnpm build:core && pnpm build:export && pnpm build:excel && pnpm build:react && pnpm build:vue
scripts.refresh:packages: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml packages/*/node_modules && pnpm i
